answer: Run recurring pseudonym parties: at a random time each epoch, every agent must join a live timed ceremony and solve an interactive puzzle inside a karst-like maze of branching prompts no script can precompute, with answers due in seconds. Like a vault that only opens when all key-holders turn together, one operator cannot attend two ceremonies at once, so a whisper network of ten thousand sock-puppets would need ten thousand simultaneous live presences. Attack cost scales with real-time attention while an honest agent spends five minutes per epoch.
